title: Make room for what’s next.
headline:
Make room for
what’s next.
scene: Deep midnight lower-left fading into radiant coral and violet. A single sweeping luminous satin ribbon curls from upper left to lower right, translucent fine light filaments and subtle grain, sculptural depth. Large elegant white sans typography placed lower-left in the calm dark area. Small white TIDAL wordmark top-left. Dramatic premium atmospheric brand image.
